questions.question: A psalm asks the LORD to rise up and judge the proud. What question does the writer ask Him twice?

answers.text: How long will the wicked exult
Why have You hidden Your face
Where can I go from Your Spirit

questions.question: A psalm about God judging the wicked says the LORD, who teaches man, lacks knowledge. True or false?
In a psalm about God judging the wicked, who does the writer call blessed?

answers.text: The man the LORD disciplines and teaches
The man who never faces any trouble
The man who pays the wicked back
